title: Custom Compression Garments and Ready Fit Garments
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY MEDICAL COMMAND.US ARMY HEALTH CONTRACTING ACTIVITY.W40M USA HCA
detail_text: Medical Readiness Contracting Office, West intends to award a Firm Fixed-Price, sole source contract to American Medical & Rehab Co, a small business, under authority FAR 13.106-1(b)(1): For purchases exceeding the simplified acquisition threshold (SAT), only one source reasonably available, urgency, exclusive licensing agreements, brand name, or industrial mobilization, for custom compression garments and ready fit garments for U.S. Army Institute of Surgical Research, Brooke Army Medical Center (BAMC), Fort Sam Houston, Texas. The applicable NAICS code for this requirement is 339113 – Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing, and the size standard is 800 employees. This notice is not a request for competitive quotes. No requests for capability briefings will be honored as a result of this notice and any information provided will not be used as part of any subsequent solicitation requirement. No telephonic inquires will be honored. A determination by the Government not to compete with this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. This is a notice of intent to award a sole source contract for Custom and Ready-Made Burn Compression Garments. The Contracting Officer determined that the circumstances of the contract action deem only one source reasonable available. The Medical Readiness Contracting Office-West intends to make a sole source award on or about 13 March 2026 to American Medical & Rehab Co, 5441 Brewster St. San Antonio, TX 78233-5725
